== Summary ==
Identified: [[Scott Lingrell]] (grey hair, glasses, light-blue Adidas jersey) and [[Tamás Papp]] (navy polo; same face as his community-card portrait). The bald man with dark-rimmed glasses and a greying beard at centre (same person as #42 in [[:File:2024 World Championship group photo.jpg]]) and the man in the doorway behind Tamás are not named. The man in the doorway behind Tamás, with glasses, is not named.


A photograph shared in the [[2024 World Championship]] Slack channel on 22 September 2024.
